commands.name: analyze

options.name: --ai
options.description: Consult an AI model (default: local Ollama) when rule  confidence is low.

options.name: --ai-model
options.description: Model name for the AI backend (overrides the provider  default).

options.name: --ai-provider
options.description: AI backend: ollama (default), anthropic, openai.

options.name: --annotations
options.description: Emit GitHub Actions ::error:: annotations per failing  test (when running under Actions).

options.name: --db-connection
options.description: Connection string for the chosen database (native  format for that engine).

options.name: --db-provider
options.description: Database backend: sqlite (default) or http.  postgres/mysql/sqlserver/mongodb need the Docker/full build; `cifail  config` lists what this binary has.

options.name: --format
options.description: Input format: auto (default), log, junit, trx. Report  formats analyze each failing test.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit machine-readable JSON instead of a human  report.

options.name: --no-git
options.description: Skip git correlation (don't tag records or  auto-resolve past failures).

options.name: --no-history
options.description: Do not persist this analysis to history.

options.name: --report
options.description: Also produce a report: sarif (GitHub Code Scanning) or markdown (PR/step summary).

options.name: --report-out
options.description: Write the --report to this file (default: stdout,  which suppresses the normal view).

options.name: --server
options.description: Talk to a remote cifail serve instance instead of a  database (e.g. http://cifail:8080).

options.name: --server-token
options.description: Bearer token for --server (falls back to  CIFAIL_SERVER_TOKEN).

options.name: --top
options.description: Maximum number of similar past failures to show.

options.name: --type
options.description: Force ecosystem  (dotnet|node|python|java|go|rust|ruby|php|cpp|infra|swift|android|generic)  instead of auto-detecting.

arguments.name: paths
arguments.description: Log file(s) to analyze. Reads stdin when omitted.

commands.description: Read a build/test log and explain what broke and how to  fix it.

options.name: --all
